subject.title: fix(cli): recover from stale session bindings

question: Should maintainers adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114926 as the single shared recovery implementation for the stale CLI binding bug, or continue reviewing this branch as the landing candidate?
rationale: The two open PRs cover the same source issue but describe different ownership boundaries. The related replacement PR says it supersedes this branch, while neither PR currently provides the live runtime proof needed to make an automatic supersession decision safe.

options.title: Adopt the shared replacement
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114926 as the canonical implementation after it supplies redacted live Gateway plus Claude CLI recovery proof, then close this PR as superseded.

options.title: Retain this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if maintainers determine its current CLI candidate boundary already covers every required direct and queued path without duplicated recovery ownership.

recommendation.title: Adopt the shared replacement
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/114926 as the canonical implementation after it supplies redacted live Gateway plus Claude CLI recovery proof, then close this PR as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked replacement design and are the clearest available routing contact for the shared-owner decision.
